observations.posthog_connection: Provides a workflow to re-score an organization after a wizard stamp, using the earliest member's identity and role, and optionally re-checking ICP fit. This could support growth team workflows that need to re-evaluate a lead after an initial enrichment or after a specific event, rather than relying solely on the initial signup enrichment.

observations.behavior: Adds a bounded dispatch pool and a dedicated dispatch entry point, dispatch_wizard_stamp_rescore, that shares the same thread pool and slot mechanism as the signup enrichment workflow.
observations.posthog_connection: Shares the bounded dispatch pool with signup dispatch so an unreachable Temporal can't pile up threads on the web pod, same as it does for signups. This could help prevent thread exhaustion and keep the web pod stable when the rescore workflow is triggered alongside signup enrichment.
